title: Multi-Model PR Audit Proof Artifact
description: Proof artifact produced by the PR audit router.  Records the risk classification, route resolution, and (when not dry-run) execution results.  Chain of custody is preserved via git_sha and packet_id.

packet_id.description: Task packet identifier for proof chain of custody.

git_sha.description: Git SHA of the HEAD commit at audit time, or 'UNKNOWN' when not available.

dry_run.description: True when no live API calls were made.  Audit plan is captured but not executed.

requested_route_names.description: Ordered list of auditor route names selected for this risk tier.

blocking_available_count.description: Number of blocking routes that are available on this host.

has_any_available.description: True when at least one route (blocking or non-blocking) is available.

executed.description: True when audit execution was attempted (live mode).

execution_results.description: Per-route execution results.  Empty when dry_run=true or executed=false.

available.description: True when the route's CLI command was found on PATH.

blocking.description: True when this route gates the audit result (xAI/OpenRouter are non-blocking by default).
